name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Your shop's own WhatsApp number now never auto-replies to a customer. When a customer messages it, ASVA quietly checks whether that number is one of your customers and whether they still owe money, and only then reads a 'paid' message or payment screenshot, matches the amount to the party, and drops it into your Payments tab - telling you privately. Customers only ever hear from you, never a bot.
The ASVA assistant number (LIST, PAID, BILL) works exactly as before.
Also carries: steadier WhatsApp reconnect, evening send window with instant Send Now, and the who-to-chase daily summary.
